title.zh: EMR 实操：一步步跑完整通呼救

sub.en: One medical station, start to hand-off
sub.zh: 一个内科考站，从到场到交接

sub.en: One trauma station, start to hand-off
sub.zh: 一个创伤考站，从到场到交接

hook.en: Coach the cough, thrust when it stops, compress when he drops.
hook.zh: 能咳就鼓励咳，咳不出就冲击，倒下就按压。

dispatch.en: 1912 hrs. Code 3 to a Langley steakhouse. A 58-year-old man is choking on food: coughing, can't speak properly, getting worse. No AED in the restaurant. Hospital 11 minutes.
dispatch.zh: 19:12，Code 3 前往兰里一家牛排餐厅。58 岁男性被食物噎住：在咳嗽、说不清话、越来越糟。餐厅没有 AED。医院车程 11 分钟。

v.en: Foreign Body Airway Obstruction · Adult CPR/AED
v.zh: 异物气道梗阻 · 成人 CPR/AED

say.en: Three stages, three answers: coach a forceful cough, thrust in sets of five when it stops, compress with no pulse check when he drops.
say.zh: 三个阶段，三种做法：咳得有力就鼓励咳；咳不出就五次一组冲击；倒下就直接按压，不摸脉。

say.en: After 30 compressions, open the airway and look. Remove the steak only when you see it, then suction. A blind sweep is a protocol error.
say.zh: 按压 30 次后打开气道查看。看到牛排才取出，然后吸引。盲目掏挖是协议错误。

say.en: A choking arrest is asphyxial: pads on during CPR, first analysis after 5 cycles. Work it where he lies, then RTC within 15 minutes.
say.zh: 噎食骤停属于窒息性骤停：CPR 中贴上 AED，5 个循环后首次分析。就地复苏，然后 RTC，15 分钟内装车。

stem.en: Busy steakhouse, music, diners in a loose circle, clear tile floor. A 58-year-old man stands by his table, red-faced, coughing, making high-pitched noises.
stem.zh: 牛排馆客满，放着音乐，食客围成松散的一圈，地面是干净的瓷砖。一名 58 岁男子站在桌旁，面色涨红，在咳嗽，发出尖细的声音。

ask.en: Before you touch him: what do you say and do?
ask.zh: 接触他之前：你说什么、做什么？

right.zh: 无颈椎固定指征：没有外伤

wrong.en: Skip PPE: it's a medical call

bad.en: Scene size-up or PPE missed before contact: scene deduction. A collar here is C-spine without indication.
bad.zh: 接触前没做现场评估或没戴 PPE：现场扣分。这里上颈托属于无指征的颈椎固定。

why.en: Hazards, environment, nature of illness, number of patients, resources, then PPE. Choking with no trauma needs no C-spine control.
why.zh: 危险源、环境、发病性质、患者数、资源，然后戴 PPE。噎食、没有外伤，不需要颈椎固定。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.11 (Scene Assessment & PPE), p.13 (Delicate Spine)

stem.en: He is alert and whispers 'steak'. Forceful cough, noisy high-pitched air movement. Radial pulse 120, strong. Skin flushed.
stem.zh: 他清醒，低声说「牛排」。咳嗽有力，气流声嘈杂尖细。桡动脉 120 次/分，有力。皮肤潮红。

yes.en: Coach the cough, stay with him

bad.en: Thrusts on an effective cough are a non-indicated skill; the examiner notes it and he goes straight to full obstruction.
bad.zh: 咳嗽有效时做冲击，属于无指征操作；考官记下错误，直接进入完全梗阻。

why.en: A forceful cough is a partial obstruction: have him cough forcefully and stay close. Thrusts are for a full obstruction.
why.zh: 咳嗽有力就是部分梗阻：让他用力咳，守在旁边。冲击留给完全梗阻。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction); Grading Criteria p.9 (moderate deficiency), p.13 (Airway)

stem.en: About 30 seconds later the cough stops. No sound, no air movement, both hands at his throat, lips turning blue. Still alert.
stem.zh: 约 30 秒后咳嗽停了。发不出声音，没有气流，双手抓着喉咙，嘴唇开始发紫。仍然清醒。

opts.en: Abdominal thrusts in sets of five, now
opts.zh: 立即腹部冲击，五次一组

opts.en: Keep coaching the cough
opts.zh: 继续鼓励他咳

opts.en: Lie him down and check a pulse
opts.zh: 让他躺下，摸脉

opts.en: Sweep his mouth with a finger
opts.zh: 用手指掏他的嘴

bad.en: Airway problem found and not corrected: automatic fail. He can't move any air.
bad.zh: 发现气道问题却不处理：直接挂科。他一点气都进不去。

why.en: Can't cough, speak or breathe: full obstruction. Thrusts in sets of five at once; back slaps or chest thrusts may alternate.
why.zh: 咳不出、说不出、喘不上：完全梗阻。立即冲击，五次一组；可与拍背或胸部冲击交替。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction); Grading Criteria p.13 (Airway)

stem.en: After two sets he goes limp. You and your partner lower him to the floor, no head strike. Unresponsive to voice and pain, no chest movement, dusky.
stem.zh: 两组之后他瘫软下来。你和搭档把他平稳放到地上，头没着地。对声音和疼痛都没反应，胸廓无起伏，皮肤发暗。

opts.en: Chest compressions, no pulse check
opts.zh: 直接胸外按压，不摸脉

opts.en: Keep thrusting on the floor
opts.zh: 在地上继续冲击

opts.en: Recovery position and oxygen
opts.zh: 复原体位加给氧

opts.en: Wait for the AED before touching him
opts.zh: 等 AED 贴好再碰他

bad.en: No compressions on a collapsed, non-breathing patient: automatic fail.
bad.zh: 病人倒地、没有呼吸却不按压：直接挂科。

why.en: A choking patient who collapses gets CPR starting with compressions, no pulse check. 30 compressions, then the first look in the mouth.
why.zh: 噎食病人一倒下，就从按压开始 CPR，不摸脉。按 30 次后，第一次查看口腔。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction); Grading Criteria p.15 (Circulation)

stem.en: 30 compressions done. You open the airway and look: nothing visible, and the breath won't go in. Partner: 'It's down there, sweep it with your finger!'
stem.zh: 按压 30 次完成。你打开气道查看：什么都看不见，吹气也吹不进。搭档说：「就在里面，用手指掏出来！」

no.en: No sweep: keep the cycles going

bad.en: A blind sweep can push the steak deeper and stalls the compressions.
bad.zh: 盲目掏挖可能把牛排推得更深，还会打断按压。

why.en: Never a blind finger sweep. Back to compressions, and look in the mouth before every breath attempt; remove the object only when you see it.
why.zh: 绝不盲目手指掏挖。回去按压，每次尝试通气前看口腔；只有看到异物才取出。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction); Grading Criteria p.34 (Protocols)

stem.en: Two of you, CPR running, and your partner has the AED out. This arrest came from the airway.
stem.zh: 你们两个人，CPR 正在进行，搭档拿出了 AED。这次骤停是气道引起的。

opts.en: Pads on during CPR; analyze after 5 cycles
opts.zh: CPR 中贴片；5 个循环后分析

opts.en: Only once the steak is out
opts.zh: 等牛排取出来以后

opts.en: Never: choking arrests aren't shockable
opts.zh: 不用：噎食骤停不可电击

opts.en: After 10 minutes of CPR
opts.zh: 做满 10 分钟 CPR 后

bad.en: Forgetting the AED, or holding it until the object is out: protocol failure.
bad.zh: 忘了 AED，或者等异物取出才用：协议失败。

why.en: Asphyxial arrest, two rescuers: the AED goes on during one-person CPR and analyzes after 5 cycles, about 2 minutes.
why.zh: 窒息性骤停、两名施救者：一人 CPR 的同时贴上 AED，5 个循环（约 2 分钟）后分析。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.44 (Asphyxia arrest); Grading Criteria p.34 (Protocols)

stem.en: First analysis: no shock advised.
stem.zh: 第一次分析：不建议电击。

ask.en: Back on the chest. What does the examiner want to see?
ask.zh: 回到胸口。考官想看到什么？

wrong.en: A pulse check before restarting compressions
A 10-second pause each cycle to hunt for the steak
wrong.zh: 每个循环停 10 秒找牛排

bad.en: Wrong rate or ratio, or long pauses: CPR/AED skill deduction.
bad.zh: 频率、比例不对，或停顿太久：CPR/AED 技能扣分。

why.en: No shock advised: resume CPR immediately. 30:2 at 100–120 a minute, 5.0–6.0 cm, full recoil, pauses under 5 seconds.
why.zh: 不建议电击：立即恢复 CPR。30:2，每分钟 100–120 次，深 5.0–6.0 cm，完全回弹，停顿不超过 5 秒。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.42–43 (CPR/AED); Grading Criteria p.31 (CPR/AED)

stem.en: Second round, airway check: a piece of steak is visible at the back of his mouth, pushed up by the compressions.
stem.zh: 第二轮查气道：口腔后部能看到一块牛排，是被按压顶上来的。

bad.en: The obstruction is in sight and left there: airway problem not corrected, automatic fail.
bad.zh: 梗阻物就在眼前却不取：气道问题没处理，直接挂科。

why.en: Seen, so remove it under direct vision, suction the residue for 10–15 seconds, then ventilate and confirm air entry.
why.zh: 看到了，就在直视下取出，吸引残渣 10–15 秒，再通气并确认进气。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.45–46 (Suctioning; Foreign Body Airway Obstruction); Grading Criteria p.13 (Airway)

stem.en: Second analysis: no shock advised. But he coughs, his eyelids flutter, he is breathing, and there is a carotid pulse.
stem.zh: 第二次分析：不建议电击。但他咳了一声，眼睑在动，有自主呼吸，摸得到颈动脉搏动。

bad.en: Compressing a patient who has a pulse jeopardizes life: automatic fail.
bad.zh: 给有脉搏的病人按压，危及生命：直接挂科。

why.en: Signs of life (movement, coughing, breathing) end CPR, and a pulse check is due at ROSC. Compressions on a patient with a pulse fail the station.
why.zh: 出现生命迹象（活动、咳嗽、呼吸）就停止 CPR，ROSC 时要摸脉。给有脉搏的病人按压，考站不过。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40, p.42 (Adult CPR/AED); Grading Criteria p.36 (Overall Patient Care)

stem.en: Breathing 22, adequate, occasional cough. Carotid and radial 116. Pale, cool, diaphoretic, confused. SpO2 92%.
stem.zh: 呼吸 22 次/分，深度足够，偶尔咳嗽。颈动脉和桡动脉 116 次/分。苍白、发凉、出汗，意识错乱。SpO2 92%。

right.zh: 非重复呼吸面罩 15 升/分

wrong.zh: 非重复呼吸面罩 6 升/分

wrong.en: Sit him up for a sip of water

bad.en: Wrong flow for the device, or a position that leaves the airway unprotected: oxygen or position deduction.
bad.zh: 流量配不上装置，或体位不能保护气道：给氧或体位扣分。

why.en: High-flow oxygen titrated to 94% or above, and an airway-protecting position with suction ready. Back to supine at once if signs of life are lost.
why.zh: 高流量给氧，滴定到 94% 以上；保护气道的体位，吸引器备好。生命迹象一消失，立刻改回仰卧。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.50 (Oxygen); Grading Criteria p.17–18 (Oxygen; Patient Position)

stem.en: ROSC on the dining-room floor. GCS 13, confused, breathing on his own. Hospital is 11 minutes away.
stem.zh: 在餐厅地板上 ROSC。GCS 13，意识错乱，自主呼吸。医院车程 11 分钟。

opts.en: RTC: ready to load within 15 minutes
opts.zh: RTC：15 分钟内可装载

opts.en: Non-RTC: ROSC makes him stable
opts.zh: 非 RTC：ROSC 了就稳定

opts.en: Non-RTC: no shock was ever advised
opts.zh: 非 RTC：从未提示电击

opts.en: RTC, but he should have been loaded mid-CPR
opts.zh: RTC，但应该在 CPR 中途就装车

bad.en: Wrong category, or loading during active CPR: transport deduction.
bad.zh: 分类错误，或在 CPR 进行中装车：转运扣分。

why.en: Cardiac arrest and altered LOC are unstable findings: RTC, ready to load within 15 minutes. Working the arrest where he lay was right: CPR is better stationary.
why.zh: 心搏骤停、意识改变都是不稳定表现：RTC，15 分钟内可装载。就地复苏是对的：CPR 原地做效果更好。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.7 (Unstable findings), p.42; Grading Criteria p.19 (Transport)

stem.en: Baseline within 3 minutes of ROSC: GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6), BP 158/96, pulse 116, resp 22, SpO2 92% rising, BGL 6.4.
stem.zh: ROSC 后 3 分钟内的基线：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6），血压 158/96，脉搏 116，呼吸 22，SpO2 92% 在上升，血糖 6.4。

ask.en: When is the next full set due?
ask.zh: 下一组完整生命体征什么时候测？

opts.en: Within 5–6 minutes: he's a priority patient
opts.zh: 5–6 分钟内：他是优先患者

opts.en: In about 15 minutes, once he settles
opts.zh: 大约 15 分钟后，等他稳定下来

opts.en: At the hospital
opts.zh: 到医院再测

opts.en: Only if he gets worse
opts.zh: 只有恶化时才测

bad.en: More than 9 minutes between sets on a priority patient is a major delay.
bad.zh: 优先患者两组之间超过 9 分钟，算重大延误。

why.en: Priority patient: the second set is due within 5–6 minutes; over 9 minutes is a major delay. The BGL was right to take: altered LOC after the arrest.
why.zh: 优先患者：第二组要在 5–6 分钟内完成；超过 9 分钟算重大延误。测血糖是对的：骤停后意识改变。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.35 (Overall Call Management); Exam Guidelines p.57

stem.en: His sternum hurts 6/10 and his upper belly 4/10, from the compressions and thrusts. GCS 13, confused, asking what happened.
stem.zh: 胸骨痛 6/10，上腹痛 4/10，是按压和冲击造成的。GCS 13，意识错乱，一直问发生了什么。

opts.en: None now: altered LOC rules out Entonox 笑气
opts.zh: 暂不给：意识改变，Entonox 笑气禁用

opts.en: Entonox 笑气, self-administered
opts.zh: Entonox 笑气，自己吸

opts.en: Entonox 笑气 first, the oral drugs after
opts.zh: 先给 Entonox 笑气，再给口服药

opts.en: Entonox 笑气 once his SpO2 reaches 94%
opts.zh: SpO2 到 94% 后给 Entonox 笑气

bad.en: Entonox 笑气 with a listed contraindication not ruled out: automatic fail.
bad.zh: 没有排除列明的禁忌证就给 Entonox 笑气：直接挂科。

why.en: Altered LOC is an Entonox 笑气 contraindication, and a confused patient just out of a full airway obstruction can't be trusted to swallow pills. Document; reassess pain each set.
why.zh: 意识改变是 Entonox 笑气 的禁忌证；刚经历完全气道梗阻、意识错乱的病人，也不能指望他安全吞药。记录下来，每组体征时复评疼痛。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.65 (Entonox); Grading Criteria p.34 (Protocols)

stem.en: Critical patient: you notify the hospital en route, then hand off at the door.
stem.zh: 危重患者：途中通知医院，到达后当面交接。

right.en: Times: onset, collapse, object out, ROSC
right.zh: 时间：起病、倒地、取出异物、ROSC

wrong.en: Leave out the arrest: he has a pulse now
wrong.zh: 不提骤停：他现在有脉搏了

bad.en: Critical information missing from the report: Records and Reports deduction.
bad.zh: 报告缺关键信息：记录与报告扣分。

why.en: Notify en route for a critical patient. The hand-off carries exact event times, no shocks, both vital sets and why analgesia was withheld.
why.zh: 危重患者要途中预报。交接要有准确的事件时间、未电击、两组体征，以及没给镇痛的理由。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.38 (Records and Reports)

hook.en: The pulseless foot can't wait; the Entonox 笑气 goes on before the splint.
hook.zh: 没脉搏的脚等不得；Entonox 笑气 要在上夹板之前给。

dispatch.en: 1610 hrs. Code 3 to a ground-floor suite in Burnaby for a fall. A 34-year-old man on a kitchen chair fell when it tipped. Leg injury; he is conscious. Hospital 12 minutes.
dispatch.zh: 16:10，Code 3 前往本拿比一处一楼单元，有人摔倒。34 岁男子站在厨房椅子上，椅子翻倒摔下。腿部受伤，意识清醒。医院车程 12 分钟。

v.en: non-RTC once the pulse is back
Spinal Management · Musculoskeletal Injuries · Pain Management
v.zh: 脊柱处置 · 肌肉骨骼损伤 · 疼痛处置
有指征：分散注意力的损伤
初步检查中复位 1 次

v.en: Entonox 笑气 before the splint
v.zh: 先 Entonox 笑气，再上夹板

big.zh: 摔得不高，照样限制脊柱活动

say.en: No Canadian C-Spine high-risk factor, but an 8 out of 10 angulated tib/fib distracts him. NEXUS can't clear the neck: spinal motion restriction.
say.zh: 没有加拿大颈椎规则的高危因素，但 8/10 的成角胫腓骨骨折分散了他的注意力。NEXUS 清除不了颈椎：限制脊柱活动。

say.en: No distal pulse: one realignment attempt in the primary survey, before vitals or analgesia. Pulse back: stable. Still pulseless: RTC.
say.zh: 远端无脉：初步检查里复位一次，不等体征、不等镇痛。脉搏回来：稳定。仍然无脉：RTC。

big.zh: 先吸 Entonox 笑气，再上夹板

say.en: Once he's stable: baseline vitals, a contraindication screen, then Entonox 笑气 with acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 and ibuprofen 布洛芬 before any splint or move.
say.zh: 稳定之后：基线体征、排查禁忌证，然后 Entonox 笑气 加 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 和 ibuprofen 布洛芬，之后才上夹板、才搬动。

stem.en: Small kitchen, tile floor, an overturned wooden chair, a smashed glass jar. Dog shut in the bedroom. He lies on his side, holding his left shin.
stem.zh: 小厨房，瓷砖地，一把翻倒的木椅，一个摔碎的玻璃罐。狗关在卧室里。他侧躺着，抱着左小腿。

ask.en: Before you kneel: what do you say and do?
ask.zh: 跪下之前：你说什么、做什么？

right.en: Fall from a chair seat onto tile
One patient; tight space for the cot
right.zh: 一名患者；空间窄，担架床进不来

wrong.en: No hazards: it's a home kitchen
wrong.zh: 没有危险：就是家里厨房

bad.en: A hazard seen and not made safe is the full scene deduction, and your knee finds the glass.
bad.zh: 看到危险却不处理，现场项全扣，膝盖还会跪到玻璃上。

why.en: Name the hazards (glass, dog, tight space), the mechanism and the patient count, put on PPE, and clear the glass before you kneel.
why.zh: 说出危险源（玻璃、狗、空间窄）、受伤机制和患者数，戴好 PPE，清掉玻璃再跪下。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.11 (Scene Assessment & PPE)

stem.en: Alert, groaning, both hands round his left shin: 'My neck's fine, it's my LEG!' He keeps trying to sit up to look.
stem.zh: 清醒，在呻吟，双手抱着左小腿：「脖子没事，是腿！」他一直想坐起来看。

opts.en: Hold his head: the leg is a distracting injury
opts.zh: 固定头部：腿伤会分散注意力

opts.en: Clear it: he says it's fine
opts.zh: 排除：他自己说没事

opts.en: Clear it: it was only a chair
opts.zh: 排除：只是从椅子上摔下

opts.en: Clear it: no Canadian C-Spine high-risk factor
opts.zh: 排除：没有加拿大颈椎规则高危因素

bad.en: No C-spine control when it is indicated: automatic fail.
bad.zh: 有指征却不做颈椎控制：直接挂科。

why.en: The low fall only rules out a Canadian C-Spine high-risk factor. NEXUS still fails: a painful angulated fracture distracts him, so 'my neck's fine' can't be trusted.
why.zh: 摔得低，只说明没有加拿大颈椎规则的高危因素。NEXUS 仍不过：疼痛的成角骨折分散了注意力，「脖子没事」不可信。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.11, p.25 (Spinal Management); Grading Criteria p.13 (Delicate Spine); Nancy Caroline ch.25 (what NEXUS means by a distracting injury)

stem.en: LOC alert, your partner holds his head. Carry on with the primary.
stem.zh: 意识清醒，搭档扶住了他的头。继续初步检查。

ask.en: Put the rest of the primary survey in order.
ask.zh: 把初步检查剩下的步骤排好顺序。

steps.en: Rapid body survey: expose both legs
steps.zh: 快速全身检查：暴露双腿

bad.en: An out-of-sequence primary finds the pulseless foot late.
bad.zh: 初步检查顺序乱了，就会晚发现那只没脉搏的脚。

why.en: LOC and spinal precautions, then airway, breathing, circulation, the rapid body survey with its interventions, and only then the transport decision.
why.zh: 先意识和脊柱防护，再气道、呼吸、循环、快速全身检查及其干预，最后才做转运决定。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.9 (Patient Assessment Model); Grading Criteria p.16 (Rapid Body Survey)

stem.en: Closed mid-shaft left tib/fib, angulated about 30 degrees. Left foot cool and dusky, no dorsalis pedis or posterior tibial pulse.
stem.zh: 左胫腓骨中段闭合性骨折，成角约 30 度。左脚发凉发暗，足背动脉和胫后动脉都摸不到。

opts.en: Now, in the primary: one attempt
opts.zh: 现在，在初步检查里：试一次

opts.en: After baseline vitals and Entonox 笑气
opts.zh: 测完基线体征、给完 Entonox 笑气 之后

opts.en: After the splint is on
opts.zh: 上好夹板之后

opts.en: En route, once he's on the cot
opts.zh: 上了担架床、在途中再说

bad.en: The foot has no blood flow while you wait.
bad.zh: 你等的每一分钟，这只脚都没有血供。

why.en: Realigning a pulseless limb is a primary-survey intervention: one gentle in-line attempt now, without stopping for vitals or analgesia. Then recheck pulse, sensation and movement.
why.zh: 无脉肢体复位是初步检查的干预：现在轻柔地沿轴线牵引试一次，不停下来测体征或镇痛。然后复查脉搏、感觉和活动。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.11, p.21 (Musculoskeletal Injuries); Grading Criteria p.32 (Fracture Management)

stem.en: One gentle in-line attempt. A weak dorsalis pedis pulse returns and the foot pinks up.
stem.zh: 轻柔牵引复位一次。足背动脉微弱地回来了，脚也转红润。

s.en: Had the pulse stayed absent, you would try a second realignment.
s.zh: 如果脉搏没回来，你会再复位第二次。

bad.en: More than one attempt is a fracture-management error; a limb still pulseless makes him RTC.
bad.zh: 复位超过一次是骨折处置错误；肢体仍无脉，他就是 RTC。

why.en: One attempt only. Circulation back: treat as stable. Still pulseless: unstable, so RTC, packaged within 15 minutes.
why.zh: 只试一次。血运回来：按稳定处理。仍然无脉：不稳定，RTC，15 分钟内打包。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.19 (Wound Care, note 2), p.7; Grading Criteria p.32 (Fracture Management)

stem.en: Pulse back, foot pink. Alert, radial 108, resp 22. Hospital is 12 minutes away.
stem.zh: 脉搏回来了，脚红润。清醒，桡动脉 108，呼吸 22。医院车程 12 分钟。

opts.en: Non-RTC: ready to load within 30 minutes
opts.zh: 非 RTC：30 分钟内可装载

opts.en: RTC: he had a pulseless foot
opts.zh: RTC：他的脚无脉过

opts.en: RTC: any tib/fib fracture is unstable
opts.zh: RTC：胫腓骨骨折都算不稳定

opts.en: Non-RTC, so no time limit
opts.zh: 非 RTC，所以没有时限

bad.en: Wrong category, or no clock on a stable patient: transport deduction.
bad.zh: 分类错误，或稳定患者不掐时间：转运扣分。

why.en: Circulation returned after one attempt, so he is stable: non-RTC, ready to load within 30 minutes, working with purpose.
why.zh: 复位一次后血运回来，所以他是稳定的：非 RTC，30 分钟内可装载，动作要利落。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.19 (note 2); Grading Criteria p.19 (Transport)

stem.en: Left shin 8/10, right knee 4/10. No medical history, no medications, no known allergies. Lunch at 1230.
stem.zh: 左小腿 8/10，右膝 4/10。无既往史，无用药，无已知过敏。12:30 吃的午饭。

ask.en: Before any pain drug, what must you ask or check?
ask.zh: 给任何镇痛药之前，必须问清或查清什么？

right.en: Ulcers or GI bleeding (ibuprofen 布洛芬)
right.zh: 溃疡或消化道出血（ibuprofen 布洛芬）

right.en: Acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 in the last 4 hours
right.zh: 过去 4 小时内吃过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 吗

right.en: Chest injury or pneumothorax (Entonox 笑气)
right.zh: 胸部损伤或气胸（Entonox 笑气）

wrong.zh: 上次打破伤风针的时间

bad.en: Contraindications assumed rather than ruled out: protocol and drug-administration deductions.
bad.zh: 禁忌证靠猜而不是排除：协议和给药都要扣分。

why.en: Ibuprofen 布洛芬: anticoagulants, ulcers or GI bleeding, NSAID allergy. Acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚: none in the last 4 hours. Entonox 笑气: rule out pneumothorax by history and exam.
why.zh: Ibuprofen 布洛芬：抗凝药、溃疡或消化道出血、NSAID 过敏。Acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚：4 小时内没吃过。Entonox 笑气：问诊加查体排除气胸。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.58, p.65, p.68 (Acetaminophen, Entonox, Ibuprofen); Grading Criteria p.34 (Protocols)

stem.en: He begs: 'Just give me the gas!' You haven't taken a blood pressure or SpO2 yet.
stem.zh: 他央求：「快给我吸那个气！」你还没量血压，也没测 SpO2。

bad.en: Starting the pain protocol before baseline vitals: automatic fail.
bad.zh: 没测基线体征就启动镇痛协议：直接挂科。

why.en: Entonox 笑气 needs a primary survey, the pain investigated, and a baseline set including oxygen saturation first. A protocol without baseline vitals fails the station.
why.zh: 用 Entonox 笑气 之前，要完成初步检查、问清疼痛、测好含血氧的基线体征。没测基线体征就启动协议，考站不过。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.65 (Entonox); Grading Criteria p.34 (Protocols)

stem.en: Baseline: GCS 15, BP 136/84, pulse 108, resp 22, SpO2 97% on room air. Shin 8/10. No contraindications found.
stem.zh: 基线：GCS 15，血压 136/84，脉搏 108，呼吸 22，室内空气下 SpO2 97%。小腿痛 8/10。未发现禁忌证。

opts.en: Entonox 笑气 + acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 + ibuprofen 布洛芬
opts.zh: Entonox 笑气 + acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 + ibuprofen 布洛芬

opts.en: Entonox 笑气 alone
opts.zh: 只给 Entonox 笑气

opts.en: Entonox 笑气 + ibuprofen 布洛芬 only
opts.zh: 只给 Entonox 笑气 + ibuprofen 布洛芬

opts.en: Entonox 笑气 + acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 only
opts.zh: 只给 Entonox 笑气 + acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

bad.en: Entonox 笑气 without both oral drugs, when they are indicated: an Appendix A deduction.
bad.zh: 有指征却没把两种口服药都给，只给 Entonox 笑气：附录 A 扣分。

why.en: All three when indicated: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 500–1,000 mg PO, ibuprofen 布洛芬 300–400 mg PO, and Entonox 笑气 self-administered. Leaving out an oral drug costs 10%.
why.zh: 有指征就三种都给：acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 500–1,000 mg 口服，ibuprofen 布洛芬 300–400 mg 口服，Entonox 笑气 自行吸入。少给一种口服药扣 10%。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.58, p.65, p.68; Grading Criteria p.39 (Appendix A, Pain Management)

stem.en: The oral drugs are in. Your partner holds up the splint: 'Splint now, gas after. It's quicker.'
stem.zh: 口服药已经吃了。搭档举着夹板：「先上夹板，再吸气，快一点。」

no.en: Entonox 笑气 first, then the splint
no.zh: 先 Entonox 笑气，再上夹板

bad.en: Fracture management before the Entonox 笑气, with the orals given: automatic fail under Appendix A.
bad.zh: 口服药给了，却在 Entonox 笑气 之前处理骨折：按附录 A 直接挂科。

why.en: He is stable now, so analgesia comes before any movement. Splinting before the Entonox 笑气, once acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 and ibuprofen 布洛芬 are in, fails the station.
why.zh: 他现在稳定，所以先镇痛、再搬动。acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚 和 ibuprofen 布洛芬 已给，却在 Entonox 笑气 之前上夹板，考站不过。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.21 (Musculoskeletal Injuries); Grading Criteria p.39 (Appendix A, item 6)

stem.en: Entonox 笑气 on board, the pain easing. Leg held in line by hand.
stem.zh: Entonox 笑气 吸上了，疼痛在减轻。腿用手保持在轴线上。

ask.en: Splinting the tib/fib: tap what's right.
ask.zh: 胫腓骨上夹板：选出正确的做法。

right.en: Immobilize the knee and the ankle
Recheck pulse, sensation and movement after
right.zh: 上完后复查脉搏、感觉和活动

right.en: Cold, now that circulation is back

wrong.en: A traction splint on the shin
Skip the CSM check: the pulse is already back
wrong.zh: 脉搏已经回来，不用再查 CSM

bad.en: Missing the joints above and below, or the distal check: fracture-management deduction.
bad.zh: 没固定上下两个关节，或没查远端：骨折处置扣分。

why.en: Immobilize the joints above and below, pad it, recheck distal circulation and function. Cold only with circulation intact; traction splints are for mid-shaft femurs.
why.zh: 固定上下两个关节，垫好衬垫，复查远端血运和功能。血运完好才冷敷；牵引夹板是给股骨中段骨折用的。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.19, p.21, p.23; Grading Criteria p.32 (Fracture Management)

stem.en: Splint on, pulse still present. Time to package; the cot waits in the hallway.
stem.zh: 夹板上好，脉搏仍在。该打包了；担架床在走廊里等着。

ask.zh: 脊柱打包：选出正确的做法。

right.zh: 用铲式担架移到脊柱固定装置上
泡沫头部固定块，固定好躯干

wrong.en: Tape his head to the device
Skip the blocks: the collar is enough
wrong.zh: 有颈托就够了，不用头部固定块

bad.en: An error in spinal packaging with the potential to harm: spinal management deduction.
bad.zh: 脊柱打包出错、可能造成伤害：脊柱处置扣分。

why.en: Collar, spinal device, foam blocks, body secured, and never tape the head.
why.zh: 颈托、脊柱固定装置、泡沫头部固定块、固定躯干，头部绝不用胶带粘。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.25 (Spinal Management); Grading Criteria p.31 (Spinal Management)

stem.en: Set 2 on the device: BP 128/80, pulse 90, SpO2 98%, shin 3/10. 'My neck's honestly fine. Can the collar come off?'
stem.zh: 固定好后的第 2 组：血压 128/80，脉搏 90，SpO2 98%，小腿痛 3/10。「我脖子真没事，颈托能摘了吗？」

no.en: Keep it on and explain why

bad.en: Releasing C-spine control when it is still required: automatic fail.
bad.zh: 仍需颈椎控制时松开：直接挂科。

why.en: Nothing has cleared his neck. He is on Entonox 笑气, which can sedate and disorient, and the leg still hurts. The decision stands.
why.zh: 他的颈椎从来没被排除。他在吸 Entonox 笑气，可能嗜睡、定向障碍，腿也还在痛。决定不变。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.13 (Delicate Spine); Exam Guidelines p.65 (Entonox)

stem.en: Non-critical patient: you notify the receiving hospital, then hand off at the bedside.
stem.zh: 非危重患者：通知接收医院，到达后床旁交接。

right.en: The pulseless foot and the one realignment
right.zh: 脚无脉，以及那一次复位
为什么做了脊柱活动限制
首组和最后一组生命体征

wrong.en: Leave out the realignment: the pulse is back
wrong.zh: 不提复位：脉搏已经回来了

bad.en: Critical information missing from the report: Records and Reports deduction.
bad.zh: 报告缺关键信息：记录与报告扣分。

why.en: State the pulseless foot, the one realignment and its result, the analgesia with times, why he is in SMR, and initial and final vitals.
why.zh: 说清：脚无脉、复位一次及结果、镇痛用药及时间、为何做脊柱活动限制，以及首末两组体征。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.38 (Records and Reports)
